summary.text: Brian Lanoue has represented Connecticut's 45th House District since 2019 and is the Republican candidate for the seat on the November 3, 2026 ballot.

paragraphs.text: As of October 2019, he lived in Griswold and was co-owner of a small, family-run business.

He graduated from Norwich Free Academy and earned a bachelor's degree in political science from Eastern Connecticut State University and a master's degree in public policy from Southern Connecticut State University.
